visual.name: Drill_Down_Timeline_PRO_By_ZoomCharts
visual.displayName: Drill Down Timeline PRO (Filter) by ZoomCharts
visual.description: Drill Down Timeline PRO (Filter) takes its foundation from Drill Down TimeSeries PRO (Filter), and lets you explore time-based data using DAX calculated measures. Additional features and improvements allow for a unique type of time series visualization and time axis customization. Click directly on the time chart to drill down to examine specific periods in detail. Combine multiple series and choose between multiple chart types (line, column, area).

dataRoles.description: Defines the drill-down hierarchy. Use hierarchies, individual fields or combinations of both. Date/time units will be determined by the field names, e.g. 'Fiscal Year' will be detected as 'Year'. Units can be singular (e.g. 'Decade', 'year'), plural (e.g. 'months', 'weeks') or shortened (e.g. 'min', 'sec'). You can define periods of multiple units by naming them '<number> <unit>' (e.g. '3 weeks', '15 minutes' or '500 ms').
dataRoles.name: Category
fromThresholdValue
dataRoles.description: Use a measure to create a dynamic threshold. 'Dynamic Threshold 1' will automatically create a threshold line if 'Threshold 1' has not been configured already. Optionally, combine with 'Dynamic Threshold 2' to create a dynamic threshold area.

dataRoles.name: toThresholdValue
dataRoles.description: Use a measure to create a dynamic threshold. 'Dynamic Threshold 2' can be used individually as a threshold line or in combination with 'Dynamic Threshold 1' to create a dynamic threshold area.

displayUnits.description: Select which display unit is displayed when the visual loads.

initialDisplayUnitMode.description:
Select whether the initial display initial unit is selected automatically or select a particular one:
'Top' (default) - the top (largest) unit is selected
'Bottom' - the bottom (smallest) unit is selected
'Custom' - select a particular unit. If more than one toggle is enabled, one of the enabled units will be selected.

lastSavedUnit.description: If enabled, the visual will remember what time range and display unit was active when the report was last saved. If 'Reset Button' is enabled in the Toolbar menu, you will see it light up as soon as you navigate away from the configured initial display unit. You can clear the saved unit by saving the report after the visual has been reset to the configured initial display unit with the 'Reset' button.
